pools.keyGuarantees: activeConditions[0] (the first condition) bands low (severityBand, or severityBand(severity)). Conditions are NOT folded into crisis kinds (crisisKind.js carrier c); only the plague / famine archetypes mirror a kind.
pools.ruling: Not scoped: deictic to its own condition, never a town-wide calm claim. Colour.

lines.text: The condition is present and light. It shows in the accounting rather than the streets.
It is a real pressure and a small one; {settlement} absorbs it without changing anything it does.
The strain registers. It does not yet cost the town anything it would miss.

pools.keyGuarantees: activeConditions[0] (the first condition) bands medium. Conditions are NOT folded into crisis kinds (crisisKind.js carrier c); only the plague / famine archetypes mirror a kind.
pools.ruling: Not scoped: deictic to its own condition, never a town-wide calm claim. Colour.

lines.text: The pressure is genuine now. Choices are being made because of it that would not have been made otherwise.
It has stopped being a line in a ledger: {settlement} is spending real capacity on this.
The condition bites. Not everywhere and not badly, but consistently enough to plan around.

pools.keyGuarantees: activeConditions[0] (the first condition) bands high. Conditions are NOT folded into crisis kinds (crisisKind.js carrier c); only the plague / famine archetypes mirror a kind.
pools.ruling: Not scoped: deictic to its own condition, never a town-wide calm claim. Colour.

lines.text: This is one of the defining facts about the town at present. Systems that ought to be independent are all bending around it.
The strain is severe. {settlement} is meeting it by giving up things it would rather keep.
The condition dominates. Whatever else is true of the town, this is truer.

pools.keyGuarantees: activeConditions[0] (the first condition) bands critical. Conditions are NOT folded into crisis kinds (crisisKind.js carrier c); only the plague / famine archetypes mirror a kind.
pools.ruling: Not scoped: deictic to its own condition, never a town-wide calm claim. Colour.

lines.text: The town is at its limit. There is no capacity left to absorb this, and nothing behind it that could absorb the next thing.
This is as far as {settlement} bends. Past this it is not the same settlement, and it is very near past this.
The condition has run past what the town was built to carry. Everything else here is now downstream of it.

pools.keyGuarantees: activeConditions[0] (the first condition) has status "worsening". Conditions are NOT folded into crisis kinds (crisisKind.js carrier c); only the plague / famine archetypes mirror a kind.
pools.ruling: Not scoped: deictic to its own condition, never a town-wide calm claim. Colour.

lines.text: It is getting worse, steadily rather than suddenly; each season costs a little more than the one before.
The trend is the wrong way. Nothing has broken yet, and nothing has stopped deteriorating either.
The condition is deepening. The town's response has not caught up with the rate.

pools.pool: DIRECTION: stable, and the FLAT case (no valid directional status)
pools.keyGuarantees: activeConditions[0] (the first condition) has status stable, absent or unrecognised (FLAT, E-3). Conditions are NOT folded into crisis kinds (crisisKind.js carrier c); only the plague / famine archetypes mirror a kind.
pools.ruling: Not scoped: deictic to its own condition, never a town-wide calm claim. Colour. "rather than a developing crisis" is about the condition itself.

lines.text: It holds where it is. Neither the pressure nor the response is gaining, and the balance has become the normal state.
The condition is level: an ongoing cost rather than a developing crisis.
Nothing here is moving. That is not relief, only the absence of change.

pools.keyGuarantees: activeConditions[0] (the first condition) has status "easing". Conditions are NOT folded into crisis kinds (crisisKind.js carrier c); only the plague / famine archetypes mirror a kind.
pools.ruling: Not scoped: deictic to its own condition, never a town-wide calm claim. Colour.

lines.text: It is lifting. Slowly, and from a level the town remembers clearly, but lifting.
The pressure is coming off. What remains is the accumulated cost rather than the cause.
The condition is receding. {settlement} has begun spending on repair rather than on holding.

pools.keyGuarantees: activeConditions[0] (the first condition) has archetype reconstruction. Conditions are NOT folded into crisis kinds (crisisKind.js carrier c); only the plague / famine archetypes mirror a kind.
pools.ruling: Opted in: a reconstruction condition can stand beside a fresh crisis, and lines 2-3 assert repair with a visible end going well, which a place held at its walls or occupied contradicts.

lines.text: The town is rebuilding. What was broken is being replaced, and the race is between the rebuilding and the memory of why it was needed.
{settlement} is in its repair season: scaffolding where there were ruins, and a great deal of work with a visible end.
The rebuild is going well enough that people have begun arguing about what it should look like rather than whether it will happen.

pools.keyGuarantees: activeConditions[0] (the first condition) has archetype boom (sustained trade and surplus). Conditions are NOT folded into crisis kinds (crisisKind.js carrier c); only the plague / famine archetypes mirror a kind.
pools.ruling: Opted in: a boom condition renders under any crisis and every line asserts plenty (prosperity, easy coin, trade in its favour), which hunger, a threat at the walls or an outside debt contradict. Empty for roughly 6 of 15 kinds plus deficit births: under half, so no twin (chair may veto).

lines.text: The town is prosperous. Trade runs in its favour, and the expectation of that has become part of the economy rather than a comment on it.
{settlement} is doing well, and quietly depends on the arteries feeding it. The boom is real and it is not self-sustaining.
Coin is easy here. The warehouses fill, the wages hold, and nobody is much interested in what the routes moving would mean.

pools.keyGuarantees: activeConditions[0] (the first condition) has archetype flourishing. Conditions are NOT folded into crisis kinds (crisisKind.js carrier c); only the plague / famine archetypes mirror a kind.
pools.ruling: Opted in: every line asserts a good, unstrained stretch; line 1 ("without strain") is calm outright, lines 2-3 deny the families that make a golden age false. That leaves the pool empty for most crisis births (9 of 15 kinds, 916 of 1,000 births carry one), so one twin.

lines.text: This is a good stretch for the town. There is room here for things that are not strictly necessary, and the accounts carry them without strain.
{settlement} is in a modest golden age. It is bounded and it is real, and the people living in it mostly know both.
The town is culturally fertile: workshops, schools, and arguments about art, all of them affordable for the first time in a while.

twins.text: The good stretch {settlement} was having has not ended, but it is being spent now on the trouble in front of it.
twins.why: flourishing beside a famine, siege, occupation, raiders, unrest, debt or plague has no drawable line; this one holds only the condition and the crisis the record carries.

pools.keyGuarantees: activeConditions[0] (the first condition) carries causes[] or triggeredAt.sourceEventType. Conditions are NOT folded into crisis kinds (crisisKind.js carrier c); only the plague / famine archetypes mirror a kind. Every line needs {reason}, which has no producer: silent even when routed.
pools.ruling: Not scoped: deictic to its own condition, never a town-wide calm claim. Colour.

lines.text: The condition traces back to {reason}, and the trace is not disputed. The town knows exactly what did this.
This began with {reason}. What {settlement} carries now is the consequence, and the consequence has outlasted the cause.
{reason} put this here. The record is clear enough that the argument in the town is about the response rather than the origin.

pools.pool: PROVENANCE: no causes[] and no sourceEventType
pools.keyGuarantees: activeConditions[0] (the first condition) carries neither causes[] nor sourceEventType. Conditions are NOT folded into crisis kinds (crisisKind.js carrier c); only the plague / famine archetypes mirror a kind. Never reached at birth (measured 0 of 14).
pools.ruling: Not scoped: deictic to its own condition, never a town-wide calm claim. Colour.

lines.text: The condition stands. Nothing in the record explains where it came from, and the town has stopped asking.
This is simply the state of {settlement}. No single event owns it, and nobody here can point to a beginning.
It is here and it is {timeband_age}. Whatever caused it did so before anyone was writing things down.
lines.note: {timeband_age} deliberately unfilled (DESK-TIMEBAND 2026-09-05): anchored liveness drops this line

pools.pool: DURATION: inside the expiry wind-down window
pools.keyGuarantees: activeConditions[0] (the first condition) has remaining <= 25% of expiresAtTicks. Conditions are NOT folded into crisis kinds (crisisKind.js carrier c); only the plague / famine archetypes mirror a kind.
pools.ruling: Not scoped: deictic to its own condition, never a town-wide calm claim. Colour.

lines.text: It is nearly over. The condition is winding down on its own schedule rather than anyone's effort.
The end of this is in sight. The pressure has begun releasing without anything in particular being fixed.
The town is at the tail of it. What is left is lifting, and nobody is treating that as an achievement.

pools.keyGuarantees: activeConditions[0] (the first condition) is of the acute-crisis family. Conditions are NOT folded into crisis kinds (crisisKind.js carrier c); only the plague / famine archetypes mirror a kind. DARK: no family field on CONDITION_ARCHETYPE_TEMPLATES.
pools.ruling: Not scoped: deictic to its own condition, never a town-wide calm claim. Colour. "{settlement} is in crisis" is licensed by the acute condition itself.

lines.text: This is an emergency the town is inside of: not a policy, not a trend, an event with a shape and an end.
{settlement} is in crisis. The condition is the town's whole agenda for as long as it lasts.
The trouble here is acute and undisguised; there is no reading of the state that does not begin with it.

pools.keyGuarantees: activeConditions[0] (the first condition) is of the regional-transmission family. Conditions are NOT folded into crisis kinds (crisisKind.js carrier c); only the plague / famine archetypes mirror a kind. DARK.
pools.ruling: Not scoped: deictic to its own condition, never a town-wide calm claim. Colour.

lines.text: The trouble did not begin here. It arrived along a connection {settlement} depends on, and the dependence is why it arrived.
This is somebody else's crisis reaching the town through the channel that normally carries something better.
What strains {settlement} is happening elsewhere. The town is exposed because it is well connected, which is the price of being well connected.

pools.keyGuarantees: activeConditions[0] (the first condition) is of the war-layer aggressor-side family. Conditions are NOT folded into crisis kinds (crisisKind.js carrier c); only the plague / famine archetypes mirror a kind. DARK.
pools.ruling: Opted in: lines 1, 2 and 4 say the war is fought elsewhere (no battle here), which a siege, an occupation or a front contradicts.

lines.text: The war is being fought elsewhere and paid for here. Men, coin and grain leave; nothing comes back on the same schedule.
{settlement} is the home of a campaign rather than its battlefield. The cost shows in the treasury and the thin garrison, not in the walls.
The town is carrying an army it does not have with it. That is a specific kind of poverty, and it compounds.
{settlement} is the home of a campaign rather than its battlefield. The cost shows in the treasury and the missing men, not in the streets.

pools.keyGuarantees: activeConditions[0] (the first condition) is of the occupation-layer family. Conditions are NOT folded into crisis kinds (crisisKind.js carrier c); only the plague / famine archetypes mirror a kind. DARK.
pools.ruling: Not scoped: deictic to its own condition, never a town-wide calm claim. Colour. The occupation is the condition's own; crisis: occupied is not required of the stress record.

lines.text: Holding this place costs more than it returns. Garrisons, administrators and suppression tie down strength that was meant for elsewhere.
{settlement} is administered by a power stretched thin doing it. Noncompliance and sabotage make the arithmetic worse each season.
The relationship here is extractive and it is expensive; both facts are true, and only one of them is written down.

pools.keyGuarantees: activeConditions[0] (the first condition) is of the recovery family. Conditions are NOT folded into crisis kinds (crisisKind.js carrier c); only the plague / famine archetypes mirror a kind. DARK.
pools.ruling: Opted in: every line says the crisis is behind the town. Calm throughout, so empty for most births (916 of 1,000 carry a crisis): one twin.

lines.text: The worst is behind {settlement}. What remains is the work of being a normal town again, which is slower than it looks.
The crisis ended and left its scars in the ordinary places: trust, institutions, and the habits people formed to survive it.
The town is recovering. It is not the town it was before, and it has not decided yet whether it minds.

twins.text: {settlement} is recovering from one trouble while it carries another, and the repair goes slower for it.
twins.why: a recovery condition beside any active crisis has no drawable line; this holds only the condition and the fact a crisis stands.
